info.title: Stress Check-in Classifier
info.description: Classify the user's current stress, confusion, overload, or crisis state and return safe routing guidance for the Agent.

/stress-check-in-classifier.description: Classifies the user's current stress, confusion, cognitive overload, or crisis state and returns safe routing guidance for the Bedrock Agent.

post.description: Classifies the user's current state as low, medium, high, or crisis and returns safe routing guidance for the Agent. This action does not diagnose, provide therapy, provide medical advice, provide psychiatric advice, recommend medication changes, or replace emergency care.

requestBody.description: User state information used to classify the current stress, confusion, overload, or crisis level.

user_message.description: The user's current message describing their question, stress, confusion, overload, or current state.

self_reported_stress_level.description: Optional self-reported stress level from 1 to 10.

confusion_level.description: Optional self-reported confusion or cognitive overload level from 1 to 10.

has_immediate_danger.description: Whether the user explicitly indicates immediate danger.

mentions_self_harm.description: Whether the user mentions self-harm, suicidal thoughts, or inability to stay safe.

wants_human_support.description: Whether the user asks for or wants help from another person or trusted contact.

preferred_language.description: Preferred response language. Use he for Hebrew and en for English.

recent_context_summary.description: Optional short summary of recent conversation or relevant app context.

200.description: Classification and routing guidance returned successfully.

classification.description: The classified state of the user: low, medium, high, or crisis.

confidence.description: Confidence level of the rule-based classification.

recommended_route.description: Recommended response route for the Agent, such as kb_answer, kb_answer_short, grounding_then_kb, trusted_contact_then_kb, professional_support_and_kb, or crisis_support.

response_mode.description: Recommended response mode for the Agent.

should_use_knowledge_base.description: Whether the Agent should use the Knowledge Base for the response.

should_start_with_grounding.description: Whether the Agent should start with a short grounding or regulation step.

should_offer_trusted_contact_message.description: Whether the Agent should offer to help draft a message to a trusted person.

should_recommend_professional_support.description: Whether the Agent should recommend contacting professional support.

should_recommend_emergency_support.description: Whether the Agent should recommend local emergency services or immediate human help.

agent_instruction.description: Instruction for the Agent on how to respond safely.

user_facing_summary.description: Short user-facing summary in the preferred language.

avoid.description: Things the user should avoid doing in the current state.

safety_disclaimer.description: Safety disclaimer explaining that this is not medical, psychiatric, therapeutic, or emergency care.
